question: If another replacement effect also tells me to exile an instant or sorcery spell, such as Dreadhorde Arcanist's, may I choose to apply Feather's replacement effect first?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you may apply Feather's replacement effect first, and its delayed trigger will return the card to your hand.
expected.answer: If another replacement effect instructs you to exile an instant or sorcery spell, such as that of Dreadhorde Arcanist or the flashback keyword, you may choose to apply Feather's replacement effect first. If you do, Feather's delayed triggered ability will return that card to your hand.
